directory.boards_note: Kuvele lapha kuphela amabhodi lapho uneso isihlalo njengamanje. Amakamelo awo ahlala eyimfihlo.
directory.lede: Thola indawo yokukhuluma, uveze ubufakazi noma ujoyine isikhungo sakho. Amakamelo aseka imibhalo, izwi nevidiyo.
directory.no_rooms: Akukho makamelo kulesi sigaba. Zama enye inhlobo yekamelo noma enye indawo.
directory.pick_place_a: Khetha indawo kusiphethilana somhlaba, bese uvula
directory.pick_place_b: ezithululweni zayo zendawo. Ukuhlala kwakho akuvimbi amakamelo omphakathi ongawavakashela.
directory.title: Amakamelo aqhuba
halls.about: Ubufakazi isitatimende sakho esingena irekhodi — ungavalisa izithamo zakho kuphela, emahholo kuphela. Irekhodi elivalisiwe alishintsheki futhi lingaphikiswa; ukulungisa kwengeza irekhodi entsha kunokubhala kabusha endala.
halls.filing_uses_after: — kuvalisa isithamo SAKHO ohlelweni lokwengeza kuphela; ungafayila okwakho kuphela.
halls.intro_after: kuvalisa esirekhodini somphakathi sokwengeza kuphela (Art. II §2) — isithamo sihlala engxoxweni; isenzo somphakathi silanda ngokungashintsheki eketshini.
halls.intro_before: Amahholo yilapho abahlali bacubungula khona imithethosivivinywa, izinhlolovo, izicelo, namakomiti. Ukufayila isithamo sakho njenge-
halls.posting_body: Ukuxoxisana emhlabathini kudinga ukuhambisana okusebenzayo kwendawo yegunya (R-03) — Art. I.
home.about: Ikhaya langemva kokungena (WF-CIV-02): zonke izinqubo ezishayayo ekuhambisaneni kwakho — ukukhetho, izikhathi zamakameresi, izicelo, izinhlolovo — kanye nekhalenda yomphakathi neirekhodi lomphakathi. Ungabuka zonke izinqubo zomphakathi; ukhuluma, unikeze ubufakazi, futhi uvote lapho uhlala khona.
home.calendar_empty: Ayikho into ekhalendeni okwamanje — izikhathi ezihleliwe nemizinsuku yokukhetho zivela lapha ngomzuzu ozovela ngazo.
home.galleries_open: Amagumbi okubuka ahlala evuliwe, futhi noma yini eqalayo izovela lapha.
home.intro: Konke okushayayo ezindaweni ohlala kuzo, konke kuseduze ngokuthinta.
home.my_record_lede: Irekhodi lakho lomphakathi lwezomphakathi — lihamba nanoma yikuphi ukuba umkhethwa esikhathini esizayo.
home.no_claim_body: Awukasho lapho uhlala khona. Menyeza umngcele omncane kakhulu ohlala kuwo; wonke amazinga ayizungezile ahambisana ngokuzenzakalela lapho iphethini yokuba khona kwakho ihlolwe — ukuvota nokuba umkhethwa kuvulwa ngakho.
home.nothing_live: Ayikho into eshayayo ezindaweni zakho njengamanje
home.rail: Ubuka konke; usebenza lapho uhlala khona. Umugqa wephepha lokuvota ukhombisa kuphela ukuthi ukuvota kuvuliwe — hhayi ukuthi uvote kanjani.
home.record_empty: Ayikho imingcele yirekhodi lomphakathi ezindaweni zakho okwamanje — wonke isenzo, ivoti, nomzuzu ushicilelwa lapha ngomzuzu ozovela ngazo.
home.residency_cite: Ukuhlala kuvumelekile → zonke izinhlangano → amalungelo avuliwe · Art. I · CLK-05
home.rights_cite: Ukuvota nokuba umkhethwa — azikho ezinye izidingo · Art. I; Art. V §1
home.rights_nonvoter: Ukuvota nokuba umkhethwa kuvuleka ngokuzenzela ngomzuzu lapho ukuhlala kuqinisekiswa khona — ukuhlala endaweni yegunya kuyona kuphela isidingo, njalo. Akukho ukuhlola ubuwena, isifundo, noma imali engengezwa phakathi kwakho namalungelo akho.
home.rights_voter: Ukuhlala lapha kuyona kuphela isidingo — lokhu kuvuleke ngomzuzu lapho ukuhlala kwakho kuqinisekiswa khona, kuzo zonke izindawo eziqukethe ikhaya lakho.
identity_verification.about: Isinyathelo sika WF-CIV-01 sika-identity, isigaba A: isiqalo sesicelo sokufakazela ngesandla kuphela. Ama-ID angaphandle okuxhumanisa indawo yegunya (ukufanisa idokhumende ngo-yes/no okubukhwephiwe, akukho okugcinwayo) afika nomfelandawonye esigabeni F; isikhulu esirekhoda ifulegi yokuqinisekisa yimishini yesigaba esizayo.
identity_verification.auto_before: Ngolunye usuku, lapho indawo yegunya ikusekela khona, uzokwazi ukuxhumanisa i-ID kahulumeni esikhona ngokufanisa ngo-yes/no okubukhwephiwe — inombolo yedokhumende ayisoze igcinwe, futhi ayisoze ithunyelwe yilutho.
identity_verification.auto_none_yet: Ayikho indawo yegunya kulo mhlaba engakwenza lokho manje
identity_verification.auto_until: . Kuze kube yilapho, isicelo sokufakazela ubusamuntu esingenhla siyona kuphela indlela, futhi nayo iyinketho ngokuphelele.
identity_verification.banner_body: Ukuvota nokuba umkhethwa kuncike ekuhlala endaweni yegunya kuphela — akukho ukuhlola ubuwena, idokhumende, isifundo, noma imali engengezwa phakathi kwakho namalungelo akho. Ukushiya le khasi kuvumelekile njalo futhi akushintshi lutho.
identity_verification.intro_after: kudingeka. Ukuvota nokuba umkhethwa kuza ngokuhlala endaweni ethile, akukho okunye. Ungakwazi uku
identity_verification.intro_before: Lapho indawo yegunya yakho ikusekela khona, ungaxhumanisa i-ID kahulumeni (ngokusemthethweni: ukuqinisekisa ubuwena) ku-akhawunti yakho. Kusiza ukugcina ukukhetho kukwethembeka — kuyinto
identity_verification.intro_link: shiya uye ngqo ekushweni kokuthi uhlala kuphi

identity_verification.pending_note: Isicelo esivela ku-{when} sesivele sisekhodini lakho — ukucela futhi nje kwengeza okungasha.
identity_verification.status_cite: Ukuqinisekisa ubunjalo kuqinisa ubuqotho bokukhetho — akulona isidingo sokuvota · Art. I; Art. II §2
journey.earn_default: izindawo lolu hambo oluthinta zizokwamukela njengomuntu owaziyo imithetho
journey.intro: Landela into yangempela njengoba ihamba emhlabeni. Isinyathelo ngasinye sikutshela okwenzekayo, ingxenye yakho, nokuthi uya kuphi. Markisa isinyathelo lapho usuqedile.
journey.marked_done: Isinyathelo simakishwe njengokuqedwe — sigcinwe emnyakazweni wakho.
journey.medal_never: Imidali ayishintshi neze ivoti, isihlalo, noma lokho ovumeleke ukukwenza.
journey.not_live: Lolu hambo alukasebenzi kulo mhlaba. Izinyathelo zalo ziboniswe ukuze zifundwe futhi azikwazi ukumakishwa.
journey.progress_yours: Umnyakazo wakho ungowakho wedwa. Ugcinelwe wena futhi awushintshi lokho umhlaba akwenzayo.
journey.reading_never_gates: kuqala. Ukufunda akukho lapho kuvalwa khona lutho.
my_record.about: Umuntu oyedwa, iphrofayili eyodwa (inkontrakthi ye-profile-v2). Ithebh que Record iyisicaba sokufunda kuphela se-audit chain (WF-SYS-03/04) esihlungwe ngokufayila kwakho; ithebhu ye-Settings ifayila F-IND-002 nge-constitutional engine ukuze ukushintsha nokungena kwakho ku-chain kwenzeke ndawonye. Ukuba umkhethwa kuyithebhu yale phrofayili efanayo — akulona ubuwena obuhlukile.
my_record.achievements_note: Irekhodi elitholakele lehambo oluphothulile kanye nezokuqala kwakho kwezomphakathi. Akukho okushintsha ivoti, isihlalo, noma lokho ovumeleke ukukwenza.
my_record.associations_caption: Izinhlangano zezindawo zegunya ezisebenzayo kuzo zonke izinga

my_record.candidacy_not_separate: Ukuba umkhethwa akulona ubuwena obuhlukile: yile phrofayili efanayo, ethathwa iye ephepheni lokuvota.
my_record.intro: Konke mayelana nempilo yakho yezomphakathi endaweni eyodwa — ukuthi ungubani, irekhodi lakho, abantu abakumelele, kanye (uma uzimisele) ukuba ngumkhethwa wakho. Izinketho zephepha lokuvota nezindawo zokuthumela imilayezo azilapha: azibhalwa neze eketshini.
my_record.multiwinner: Izihlalo ezinabaningi abanqobayo ziphendula wonke umhlali · Art. II §2

petitions.about: Ukusayinela (F-IND-010) kuvulelekile kunoma yimuphi umhlali u-R-03 ohambisana nendawo yegunya yesicelo — akudingeki kube ngumcelo ukuze usayine. Umsuka yizithombe: isisekelo sabantu basemzini nepesenti eqondisiwe kugcinwa lapho kudalwa (CLK-17).

petitions.creation_body: Ukudala isicelo kudinga ukuhambisana nokuhamba nendawo yegunya okusebenzayo (R-03) — isango elifanayo nokuvota nokuba umkhethwa, futhi yisona sodwa (Art. I).
petitions.intro: Noma ubani ohlala lapha angabhala umthetho bese awubeka ukuze kuvotwe. Finyelela emngceleni wezimpawu, dlula ukuhlolwa okuzimele kanye nokubuyekezwa komthethosisekelo, bese isiphakamiso sakho siba ephepheni lokuvota elilandelayo lendawo yegunya.
petitions.law_text_hint: Bhala umbhalo ozobopheza, hhayi isifinyezo — lokhu yilokho abavoti abakuvuma. Kubuyekezwa ngokomthethosisekelo ngaphambi kokubekwa ephepheni lokuvota.

private_room.channel_not_up: Isigaba esisebenzayo saleli gumbi asikahleliwe — zama futhi maduze.

private_room.text_voice_note: Umbhalo nezwi/ividiyo kuyasebenza lapha; izinhlelo zokunamathisela izifayizela azikawukuxhunywa.
public_square.about: Izimpendulo, ukulandela, nokuvimba abasebenzisi ngamunye kuhlala kudivayisi yakho futhi akishayelwa phambili. Isithamo singasuswa kuphela ngaphansi kokukhipha okurekhodiwe (isinqumo sobulungiswa, noma ukuvikela amalungelo omunye) — ukususa konke okunjalo kuyirekhodi lomphakathi elingaphikiswa.
public_square.intro: Isikwele somphakathi sivulekile kubo bonke abahlali bendawo yegunya. Noma ubani ohambisana nalo angathumela; akekho — osebenza, isishayamthetho, noma ijaji — ongasuswa isithamo ngenxa yombono. Ukususa okukodwa kuphela kungama-carve-outs amane amancane, arekhodiwe (Art. I).
public_square.no_threads: Ayikho imigqa yokuxoxa okwamanje — noma yimuphi umhlali ohambisana nalo angavula.
public_square.posting_body: Ukuthumela esikweleni kudinga ukuhambisana okusebenzayo nendawo yegunya (R-03) — isango esifanayo nokuvota, futhi siyiso sodwa (Art. I).
reach.activating_body: Abantu abambalala kakhulu abaqinisekise lapha ukuze kubonakale inombolo ngokuphepha — ukuyishicilela kungakhombisa abantu ngabanye. Isilinganiso sivelaphi lapho abahlali abanele sebejoyine.
reach.capped_note: Abantu abaningi baqinisekise lapha kunalokho isilinganiso esivumela — isilinganiso sishiye le ndawo. Inombolo eyiqiniso ngu {figure}%.
reach.count_hidden_body: Isibalo sihlala sifihliwe ngenkathi sincane, ngakho le khasi alikwazi ukusho ukuthi bangaki ababadingeka ngaphandle kokudalula ukuthi bangaki asebe lapha.
reach.gates_a: Lokhu kuvimba kuphela lapho uhulumeni engakwenza
reach.gates_b: — akukona neze ivoti yomuntu noma ilungelo lokumela isihlalo. Lokho kudinga ukuhlala nokunye kuphela.
reach.gauge_banner: Isilinganiso, hhayi ithuluzi — ukufika akushintshi navoti, nesihlalo, nelungelo. Izindawo kuphela ezilinganiswa, hhayi abantu. Akusona isinqumo sokusebenza kwe Art. VI §3, okungumbuzo mayelana nokuthembeka nokubuyisela, hhayi isibalo sabantu.
reach.intro: Bangaki babantu abahlala endaweni abaqinisekise ukuhlala kwabo lapha. Isignali yokuthi indawo iphila kangakanani, futhi akukho okunye.
reach.over_time_note: Izithombe zasemini. Noma yikuphi ubusuku lapho isibalo besincane kakhulu ukuze siphephe, ukujula kuyama nje kunokuba kukhombise uzero.
reach.threshold_disabled: Imingcele ayikawukhiwa kulo mhlaba — umhlali oyedwa oqinisekisiwe wakwanele ukuqala uhulumeni.
reach.threshold_enabled: Umngcele uvela kubantu: cishe impande yesithathu yabantu abahlala lapha, egcinwe phakathi kuka {floor} no {cap}.
reach.unmeasurable_body: Alikho isilinganiso sabantu sale ndawo okwamanje, ngakho ukufika akukwazi ukulinganiswa. Lokhu akukona ukuthi akukho muntu ohlala lapha.

relocation.grace_meter_label: Isikhathi somusa — umngcele ka CLK-05 wezikhetho ezintsha
relocation.held_offices_body: Ihhovisi elihambisana nendawo yegunya alilahleki ngaleso sikhathi uthutha ngaso — isikhathi somusa sivumela isikhungo ukuba silungiselele ngenkathi usabophezelele.
relocation.intro: Ukuhlala kwakho kulandela lapho uhlala khona empeleni. Lapho kuvela iphethini yokuba khona okuqhubekayo ngaphandle kwendawo yakho yegunya yasekhaya, uhlelo luyabuza — alukuphenduli ngokuthula, futhi alukujezisi ngokuhamba.
relocation.lifecycle_body: Isicelo sakho sakudala sokuhlala siba nguKuthathwe indawo ngokunye kuphela lapho esisha kuqinisekiswa —
relocation.moving_note: Ukuthutha: isimemelo esisha sokuhlala (F-IND-003 esikrinini sokuhlala) kanye nesicelo sakho esisebenza YIKHO ukuthutha — ayikho ifomu entsha lapha, ngokuhlelwa.
relocation.no_office: Awuphethe nakuyiphi ihhovisi ehambisana nendawo yegunya yakho yasekhaya — akukho okuhambiselwayo
relocation.reassoc_note: Uma ukuhlangana kabusha kuphothulwa, isihlalo simenywa njengesihlalo esingenamuntu (F-LEG-036, kufayilwe uhlelo) bese zigcwaliswa ngokubala kabusha (WF-ELE-03) — amaphepha lokuvota angaphambilini abalwa kabusha kukhishwe ilungu elishiyile. Uma uhlala, akukho okushintshayo.
relocation.stays_active_b: (Kuthathwe indawo-kulindile) kuze kube yilapho lesi sicelo siqinisekiswa — ukuhambiselwa kwenza kube yinto eyodwa ekuhlolweni.
relocation.step2_action: Ufomu lokukude luqoqwa kuze kufike emngceleni (CLK-05)
relocation.step2_outcome: Ukuhlangana kwakudala kuhlala kusebenza ngokugcwele kuze kube yilapho — akukho sikhala ekuvoteni noma ekubeni umkhethwa.
relocation.step3_action: Ukuhlangana kuyadluliswa; amahhovisi aphethwe axazululwa ngesikhathi somusa
relocation.step3_outcome: Imisebenzi yakudala iphela ngokuhamba kancane; isihlalo esiphethwe siyashiywa kuye ekubalweni kabusha (F-LEG-036 → WF-ELE-03); ozakwethu bomfelandawonye bayaziswa.
relocation.travel_or_move_body: Tshela uhlelo ukuthi yikuphi lokhu. Noma iyiphi impendulo iba wukugcina kuphela lapho usho njalo — kanti ukuthutha kusadinga uphethiloni lomngcele ophelele ngaphambi kokuba konke kudluliswe.
relocation.travelling_detection: Uhambile: ukubona kuqala kabusha, akukho okushintshayo — ama-ping angamiswa ezilungelweni zomuntu; isimemelo sinoxhumano lweirekhodi lokucwaninga (WF-CIV-03).
relocation.travelling_none: Uhambile: akukho ufomu lokukude olutholwe — akukho okudinga ukuqala kabusha — ngakho lokhu isimemelo esimi ukuthi uhambo lwakusasa luwuhambo, hhayi ukuthutha. Lokhu kubhalwe irekhodi lokucwaninga (WF-CIV-03) futhi akushintshi lutho ngokuhlala kwakho noma amalungelo akho.
relocation.vacancy_cite: Isihlalo esingenamuntu → ukubala kabusha → ukubuyela ekukhethweni okukhethekile (90–180 zinsuku · CLK-04) · Art. II §5 · Art. V §1–2
relocation.zero_gap_body: Ukuvota, ukuphikisa, kanye zonke izinhlangano zigcinwe kulo lonke ushintsho
relocation.zero_gap_title: Isicelo sakho sakudala sihlala Sisebenza kuze kube yilapho esisha siQinisekisa — akukho sikhala samalungelo, nakaze
residency.about: WF-CIV-02 ukusungulwa kokuhlala — isimemezelo, ukuqapha kokungena, isilinganiso, ukuqinisekisa, kanye nokuhlola inhlangano konke kwenzeka kulokhu. Imishini yezinto: Isicelo Sokuhlala ({machine}) kanye Nomuntu (R-02 → R-03).
residency.belong_count: Ungowendawo {count} {plural} ngesikhathi esisodwa, futhi ungavota uphikelele nesihlalo kuyo yonke leyo ndawo:
residency.change_restart: Ukushintsha ikhaya lakho kuqala izinsuku zokungena kabusha endaweni entsha.
residency.checkin_body: Vula le khasi ngenkathi usekhaya bese uyangena. Zonke izinsuku zibalwa kanye. Indawo yakho ihlala iyimfihlo; kubalwa izinsuku kuphela. Lapho usufike ezinsukwini {days} uzocelwa ukuqinisekisa.
residency.checkin_note: ukungena kanye ngosuku, kusuka phakathi kwe-{home}
residency.confirm_belong: Qinisekisa bese uba ngowazo zonke izindawo ezikuhlanganisa.
residency.consent_instant: Ngiqinisekisa ukuthi yilapha lapho ngihlala khona. Indawo yami iyimfihlo futhi isetshenziselwa kuphela ukungibeka lapha.
residency.consent_monitored: Ngivuma ukungena kusuka ekhaya ezinsukwini ezi-{days} ezizayo ukuze ukuhlala kwami kuqinisekiswe. Ukungena kuyimfihlo; kubalwa izinsuku kuphela, futhi izindawo zisuswa lapho sengiqinisekiswa.
residency.declare_body: Sebenzisa indawo okuyo njengamanje, noma uchofoze ikhaya lakho emaphephu. Kubhalwa indawo ohlala kuyo kuphela, hhayi iphuzu eliqondile.
residency.geo_failed_coords: Kukwazalekanga ukufunda indawo yakho. Faka izinkukhu zakho ngezansi.
residency.geo_failed_map: Kukwazalekanga ukufunda indawo yakho. Chofoza ikhaya lakho emaphephwini esibalo.
residency.grant_already: Usulungiswe sengathi ungumhlali we-{name} — akukho okumele kwenziwe.
residency.grant_targets: izinhloso {name} · amafayela angempela F-IND-003/005/006 · uthuthuka uma eseqinisekiswe
residency.intro: Sitshele ukuthi uhlala kuphi. Lokho kuphela okudingekayo. Uma ikhaya lakho seqinisekiswe, uba yingxenye yawo wonke amada akuhlanganisa, futhi ungavota uphinde umele isihlalo kulo lonke.
residency.locked_h2: Uzazise ukuthi u-{home}. Manje khombisa ukuthi uhlala lapho.
residency.monitored_note: Bese uzibhalise uvela ekhaya izinsuku ezi-{days} bese uqinisekiswa.
residency.no_geo_coords: Ibh라우za yakho ayikwazi ukwabelana ngendawo yakho. Faka izinkukhu zakho ngezansi.
residency.no_geo_map: Ibh라우za yakho ayikwazi ukwabelana ngendawo yakho. Chofoza ikhaya lakho emaphephwini esibalo.
residency.no_tiles: Ayikho imaphephu elandiswe kuleli bhokisi. Sebenzisa indawo yakho yamanje noma seshe ngegama ngezansi.
residency.or_click_map: noma chofoza ikhaya lakho emaphephwini esibalo
residency.place_name_hint: Bhala igama ledolobha, isifunda, isifunda esikhulu noma izwe ohlala kulo. Izikheli zemigwaqo azifunwa.
residency.place_name_placeholder: isib. Anne Arundel, New York, Serravalle
residency.privacy_body: Izindawo zibhalwe ngendlela efihliwe, azikhonyiswa kubani, futhi zisuswe lapho useqinisekiswe. Inani lezinsuku kuphela elibonakala.
residency.roles_cite: kutholakala ku-R-01 Umuntu · ukuqinisekisa kudala ukuhlala okuqinisekisiwe kanye nayo yonke inhlangano yendawo yegunya (R-03) · Art. I; Art. V §1
residency.server_unreachable: Kukwazala ukufinyelela kuserba. Hlola uxhumano lwakho uzame futhi.
